changes.evidence: The record is on file for Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7 with the Chronicom LMD Coulson, who serves with Mack's S.H.I.E.L.D. team through the whole season (activated in S6E13, time-travels with the Zephyr in S7) and in the finale (S7E13 'What We're Fighting For') takes a sabbatical from S.H.I.E.L.D. to see the world (a sabbatical, not a departure, so no left title). The record's last stage is Independent from S5, so his S7 service is missing. The 'left' title Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5 (retiring to Tahiti) stays. Note: the MCU wiki gives this LMD its own page, so if the owner would rather split him out, this stage goes with him.

Past group missing. In Thor: Ragnarok Thor names the group ('The Valkyrie are legend. Elite warriors of Asgard, sworn to defend the throne'), and a flashback shows her riding with the Valkyrie against Hela. Hela kills all of them except her, and she leaves Asgard for Sakaar.

owner_calls.question: In The Avengers Selvig serves Loki under the scepter's mind control: he builds and opens the portal at Stark Tower until he is freed in the same film. That is brainwashed service under the owner's rules, but the screen never names Loki's group of mind-controlled people. The dataset files Loki (A:loki, T:loki) under 'The Chitauri' for The Avengers, and Clint Barton's record has no stage for this either. Should Selvig get a stage, and under what name?
options: Add ["The Chitauri", "The Avengers"], then ["S.H.I.E.L.D.", "The Avengers"] once he is freed, keeping the later stage
Add a stage under some other name for Loki's mind-controlled people (and do the same for Clint Barton)
Leave it out (Loki's control is not a group)
owner_calls.evidence: The Avengers: Loki takes Selvig with the scepter at the S.H.I.E.L.D. Joint Dark Energy facility. Selvig builds the portal device and opens it on Stark Tower, then, free of control, tells Natasha how to close it. The MCU wiki biography section is 'Controlled by Loki', and its affiliations list no Loki group.
